test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following lakes was formed by meteorite impact during the Neolithic era?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lonar Lake, Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lonar lake is a saline lake located in** ****Buldhana district, Maharashtra.**
 
• It is formed after a meteorite impact led to crater formation.
 
• It has been designated as a **Ramsar site**
